n_diagnoses.Description: Number of DSM-5 diagnoses met at or above clinical threshold on the ADIS-5.

acute_stress_disorder.Description: Whether the participant met DSM-5 criteria for acute stress disorder on the Anxiety and Related Disorders Interview Schedule for DSM-5 (ADIS-5; Brown & Barlow, 2014), administered at the first study visit by trained post-baccalaureate and graduate student diagnosticians. Final diagnoses were determined in weekly consensus meetings led by the PI.
